notes.title: THE DREADFUL SPACE CHALLENGE
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42171906/b30c0e5421d9e2f8b51ee51ecb9b2893c8dc8fd7.png

A game with a lot of space war action, the mission is to fight ships from other planets, the game requires a lot of skill to get rid of enemy shots and counterattack with all the cool resources you can get in the game. The combat is intense and very agile, challenging your skills as a Battleship player.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42171906/bbbb398bf60c184d7d2ddca2cf09b761537e3c53.png


The player has the mission to protect planet Earth against enemy ships, you will destroy many ships, your war will be intense and full of danger and with a lot of emotion. Make your ship very powerful with resources acquired in space when you destroy ships with technologies. Steal their technologies, increase your combat power and complete the most dangerous mission ever sent to a pilot.



GAME FEATURES

• Game Action - The game contains intense space war action, it is very explosive and strategic, with wisdom for the player to use their items and evolve their ship with technology from other planets.

• The Gameplay – The game contains a dynamic of precise and fast movements to match the pilot's agility, with a shooting scheme that the player does not need to release the button to shoot or use in any way he sees fit. attack enemies, a gameplay scheme with precise and compatible controls.

• Your Weapons – The ship's asthma can absorb technologies from ships destroyed in space and increase its power, there are several types of weapons that you can acquire during the game, one of which is very cool, These are guided missiles.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42171906/eb9f3934b504506db7fde8a713690434b0723228.png

• Destruction – Destroying enemy ships is a pleasure, with a feeling of victory with each achievement, defeating the masters of the stage is difficult and requires a good skill for the player, but with your weapons and resources your mission is fine.

• The Planet - Your planet needs you very much, if you let ships from other planets reach planet Earth, your mission will fail and they will chase you even in your dreams until you play again and destroy all.

• Achievements – STEAM achievements are well earned in each specific phase and mission, win them all by being a good Pilot, the game contains 14 specific achievements.

• Graphics – The game has very beautiful graphics that are pleasing to the eye, with minimalist details, the player will enter a totally new universe full of battles.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42171906/a637ab8dc0373bf664de06d32d16b30c9c43f870.png




Use your Bombs
Use your Missiles
Shoot at Will
DESTROY THEM ALL!

THE DREADFUL SPACE game also changed the gameplay a little bit improving the in-game experience.
